end.summary:
Named oxygen, nitrogen and carbon with their states: gases and solid respectively.
Identified iodine as a solid and explained sublimation and sealed storage.
Connected oxygen with respiration, hospital oxygen and rocket-fuel burning.
Identified nitrogen in chips packets and iodine in iodised salt.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; fertiliser use remained unconfirmed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised non-metal states and everyday uses with Pari. They used examples and explained iodine’s sublimation clearly, and correctly linked nitrogen with keeping chips crisp. There was a mix-up about oxygen and fertilisers; they later identified nitrogen in chips, but the fertiliser point was not revisited. At home, ask them to make a two-column list of non-metals and one everyday use for each.
